description: This file declares interfaces for a message dispatcher and its client, including factory methods for creating dispatcher clients that interact with media keys.

classes.name: IMessageDispatcherClient
classes.description: Interface for the message dispatcher client, with a virtual destructor.

classes.name: IMessageDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for the message dispatcher, providing a method to create dispatcher clients.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to an IMessageDispatcherClient, given an IMediaKeysClient pointer.
